title: Quenched Spicy Slovakian Tiger Prawns Skewers
description: A peppery and snappy Slovakian dish featuring tiger prawns, perfect for a date night, with a satvik-friendly twist by using bhuna spice blend, this recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the bhuna spice blend to the bowl and mix well.
Add the tiger prawns to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated prawns onto skewers, leaving a small space between each prawn.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of quinoa or roasted vegetables for a complete meal.
